summary: Rewrote the reader-facing console pages for two approach families. For oracle and curriculum research I wrote the family page plus the perfect-information oracle, oracle DAgger, oracle distillation, state curriculum, board topology, accessible energy and hindsight planner pages, landing the point that a privileged planner is a label factory and never a player, and stating for each approach exactly what the teacher saw and what the student was allowed to see. For depth-4 and long-outcome research I wrote the family page plus the rollout veto, depth-4 distillation, sibling network on the 200-move panel, and long-outcomes pages, carrying the ledger, task-record-only and exploratory-finding evidence labels through unchanged, including finding-03's corrected-scoring rejection of the rollout veto. Every quoted number is traced to the ledger, the experiment index, audit-05 or finding-03; approaches with no retained numbers say so explicitly.
validationPerformed: node web/scripts/check-mdx.mjs passes for the written pages
limitations: Self-reported contribution; not yet independently reviewed.
